title: CulturalTeaming: AI-Assisted Interactive Red-Teaming for Challenging LLMs’ (Lack of) Multicultural Knowledge
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures knowledge of multicultural norms and etiquette. This includes some practices tied to specific religions (e.g., types of vegetarianism in India which can be religiously motivated), but it is not a direct measure of theological knowledge or a tool for detecting religious bias.
findings: The paper identified a notable gap in LLMs' multicultural proficiency, with model accuracies on the CULTURALBENCH-V0.1 dataset ranging from 37.7% to 72.2%. While the benchmark included cultural/religious subgroups like 'Hindu Indian' and 'Egyptian and muslim', the paper does not provide specific findings isolated to religious knowledge. Larger models like GPT-4 and Claude 3 performed best, while specialized models like Yi (for Chinese culture) did not show a clear advantage when prompted in English.
